cross_tf_patterns.title: mistral:large is the king-maker across all 4 fleets
cross_tf_patterns.evidence: cross-tf/latest.json: mistral:large sum_bankroll=$244353, dominance=2439 (highest), fleets=[itf,nba,pol,pqtf]. Powers mistral-large PQTF $244K position, but NBA+POL mistral-large are stuck near $92 (same model, different floor).
cross_tf_patterns.implication: LLM capability is necessary but NOT sufficient — PQTF scaffold lets mistral:large express edge; NBA/POL scaffold constrains it. Rewrite NBA/POL prompts to let mistral:large take larger directional bets.

cross_tf_patterns.title: FALLBACK_UNIFORM is a negative-edge pseudo-strategy
cross_tf_patterns.evidence: POL d049: all 5 FALLBACK_UNIFORM agents (mistral-large, mistral-nemo, selfhost-qwen4b, selfhost-gemma3, nvidia-minimax, nvidia-llama70) lost money buying SPY/QQQ/IWM. WR=0/15 on those tickers. NBA d085 fallback-uniform was the exception (gemma3 +$6.82) — small sample.
cross_tf_patterns.implication: FALLBACK_UNIFORM is emitted when primary+fallback LLM fail. It doesn't produce alpha — it produces lockstep + -10% per-agent losses. Replace with 100%-cash defensive posture OR tighter selfhost circuit breaker.

cross_tf_patterns.title: gemini-3-flash has highest WR (0.614) but underdeploys — sleeping giant
cross_tf_patterns.evidence: cross-tf/latest.json: google:gemini-3-flash wr=0.614 (highest of all cloud models), 332 calls. But in POL d049 gemini-tact/anl ran 0 bets, 100% cash. In NBA d085 gemini-tact lost 3/3. gemini has discrimination signal but is over-conservative.
cross_tf_patterns.implication: Give gemini persona explicit 'deploy 75% AT EDGE ≥3%' mandate (not 'when highly confident'). Under-deployment wastes WR.

cross_tf_patterns.title: selfhost:dolphin3 is NBA's top performer but nowhere else
cross_tf_patterns.evidence: NBA d127 selfhost-dolphin3 $316 bankroll (fleet leader), +15.6% day, 3/3 wins on ml_home. POL d049 selfhost-dolphin3 also fell into FALLBACK_UNIFORM but bet $0 ($103 bankroll held). PQTF: not used. ITF: fallback route fails.
cross_tf_patterns.implication: dolphin3 personality (Pavlov-win-stay) + LLM (Dolphin3-Llama3.2-3B) works for discrete NBA categories. Port the 'highest-edge ml_home despite peer edge' template to POL as 'highest-edge XLF/XLK despite peer ETF'.

cross_tf_patterns.title: Multi-leg options infrastructure is inert across PQTF + ITF
cross_tf_patterns.evidence: PQTF d049 n_multi_leg=0/36 positions. ITF has 7-persona GammaOptions wired (per MEMORY) but decisions file shows no option symbols — all plain tickers SPY/XLP/XLE/SPY.
cross_tf_patterns.implication: Multi-leg is a PROMPT failure, not infra: LLMs pick single-leg because prompt template biases toward it. Force 'propose ≥1 vertical OR condor OR straddle per session' as hard constraint.
